- Executive alignment (contract owner confirmed)
- SOW draft accepted or in active negotiation
- Adoption metrics: DAU/seat usage trend for core features

2) Can Ben confirm expected seats/licenses to be purchased (ballpark OK)?
3) Any procurement blockers we should track (vendor approval, legal SLA asks)?

Thanks —
